messages:
sam_support: FYI — major customer (Chronicle) just escalated: intermittent 502/504s hitting hosted inference since 07:20 UTC, lots of client timeouts. They reported a spike right after a token refresh rollout. Example curl repro attached.

sam_support: curl -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -> 504 after ~30s.

sam_support: adding logs they sent: `upstream: http://inference-gateway:8080/ -> 502` and `auth-proxy: token refresh 429 -> upstream timeout`

june_oncall: thanks, oncall looking. tagging @marc_eng @raj_sre. any idea if the auth refresh rollout touched EU region? :eyes:

marc_eng: I saw a small auth proxy rollout at 07:15 (canary, 10%). It's the new refresh backoff code. Not rolled to 100% yet.

raj_sre: correlating metrics now. p90 gateway latency jumped at 07:18 in eu-west-1 and eu-central. Error rate to inference backend shows increased 502/504 for requests with cache-miss tokens.

sam_support: customer timeline matches (spike 07:20). They said retries amplified. They raised billing questions too because a lot of token charges went up.

leigh_support: customer wants quick mitigation. Can we rollback canary or add a temporary passthrough?

marc_eng: I can roll back the auth-proxy canary to previous image (15% -> 0%) now. Rolling back will stop the new backoff logic. Doing it in eu-west first.

deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-proxy.eu-west-1 -> image v2.4.1-canary -> rollback to v2.4.0 (initiated by marc_eng)

raj_sre: while rollback runs, we should enable gateway circuit-breaker to fail fast for auth-proxy upstream on 5xx/timeout so client retries don't flood the backend. Adding a 500ms short-circuit for auth timeouts.

marc_eng: rollback complete in eu-west-1. Monitoring...

ops_bot: rollback verified: auth-proxy eu-west-1 is now v2.4.0. No ongoing canaries.

raj_sre: post-rollback telemetry: error rate dropping, p95 latency improving, but there's residual queueing — need to flush backlog.

june_oncall: can we spin up extra inference workers temporarily and bump autoscaler? Action item?

marc_eng: yes — manual scale +2 nodes in eu-west and eu-central for 30m. Doing now.

deploy-bot: scaling event: inference-pool.eu-west-1 +2 nodes (requested by marc_eng)

sam_support: told customer we rolled back canary and scaled capacity. They're seeing fewer 502s but still some long tails. They asked for a repro/playbook so they can avoid excess retries in the meantime.

leigh_support: customer-facing summary drafted: "We identified a canary change in auth refresh backoff that correlated with increased gateway timeouts; we rolled back the canary, scaled capacity, and enabled circuit-breaking to reduce amplification. Follow-up: full postmortem and permanent fix to backoff logic."

marc_eng: short-term mitigation tasks:
- rollback canary (done) — owner: marc_eng
- enable auth upstream circuit-breaker (done) — owner: raj_sre
- scale inference pool +2 nodes (done) — owner: marc_eng
- customer comms (drafted) — owner: leigh_support

raj_sre: follow-up action items for postmortem (assign and ETA):
- reproduce locally: create test harness for token refresh 429 -> failover behavior (owner: marc_eng, ETA: 48h)
- add rate-limited token refresh queue and backpressure (owner: eng-runtime, ETA: 2w)
- add observability: trace span for token refresh path + tag requests that hit new backoff (owner: eng-obs, ETA: 1w)
- update retry guidance in SDK to use exponential backoff with jitter and max attempts = 3 (owner: sdk-team, ETA: 3d)
- billing reconciliation: retroactively credit customers impacted by excessive retries (owner: finance + support, ETA: 5d)

sam_support: capturing repro steps we used here:
1) in test cluster, inject 429s from auth service for 20% of token refresh calls
2) run 500 concurrent generate requests with sdk configured to retry x3 fast
3) observe gateway queue depth and 502/504 rates

marc_eng: adding a temporary server-side throttle to token refresh path to smooth bursts during rollout windows. Will PR today.

raj_sre: post-incident: create an autoscaling policy rollback guard for canaries that increase auth error rate >2x within 10m (owner: eng-sre, ETA: 1w).

leigh_support: leaving note for customer: "We are deploying mitigations and a postmortem; we will follow up with credits and an action timeline."

june_oncall: good recovery. Please file a postmortem doc and link to this thread. Include metrics dashboard snapshots and the minimal repro harness.

sam_support: filing a postmortem now and will ping when done. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

marc_eng: quick log snippet for PM: `auth-proxy: refresh_attempt=3 status=429 backoff_ms=0 -> 429s amplified upstream requests -> gateway timeout`

ops_bot: incident resolved (transient). Severity: S2. Timeline recorded.

sam_support: closing loop with customer in 30m after final telemetry check.

june_oncall: ✅ follow-up owners assigned in the postmortem draft.

sam_support: last: customer confirms lower error rate at 08:05 UTC. Will update postmortem with final numbers."
